title: Autonomous landing system using a parafoil
author: Raphael Galate Baptista Ribeiro
abstract: This work sets forth the conception, project and implementation of an autonomous system composed of a parachute in parafoil aerodynamic format with a guidance, navigation and control embedded system and which objective is the enabling of landing of airdroped payloads bringing them back to a pre-defined position. The major milestones foreseen for this project are: the definition of specifications and systems engineering, detailed project of systems, construction of a prototype, tests and evaluation of results. Simulations of the parafoil and payload system dynamics were made, a prototype of the parafoil was constructed. A plan for flight validation is suggested as future work.
